in_sanskrit.name: Rampukar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Rama's Army
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rampukar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ram-pū-kar means 'God of Rama's Army'. In Hindu mythology, Rama is an incarnation of the god Vishnu and the prince of Ayodhya. The army of Rama, known as the Vanara Sena, was a group of monkey and bear soldiers who helped Rama in his war against the demon king Ravana. Pū-kar can be translated to 'warrior' or 'soldier'. Therefore, the name Rampukar signifies a brave and powerful warrior who fights for justice and righteousness.
